PUBLIC MEETING ANNOUNCEMENT

Title:                 Duane Arnold Energy Center: Pre-submittal Meeting for Planned License
                       Amendment Request

Date(s) and Time(s):
                        December 15, 2026, 11:00 AM to 12:15 PM


Location:              Hybrid
                       One White Flint North Room OWFN-08B04
                       11555 Rockville Pike
                       Rockville MD

Category:              This is an Observation Meeting. This is a meeting in which attendees will have an
                       opportunity to observe the NRC performing its regulatory function or discussing
                       regulatory issues. Attendees will have an opportunity to ask questions of the
                       NRC staff or make comments about the issues discussed following the business
                       portion of the meeting; however, the NRC is not actively soliciting comments
                       towards regulatory decisions at this meeting.

Purpose:               The purpose of this meeting between the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission
                       staff and representatives of NextEra Energy Duane Arnold, LLC (NEDA), is to
                       discuss a planned license amendment request (LAR) for the Duane Arnold
                       Energy Center, which, if approved would revise the spent fuel pool criticality
                       analysis to support storage of ATRIUM 11 fuel.
